Messages.Author: MikeM...@my-dejanews.com
Messages.Body:
And another two questions round the use of Anathema.

1. If Anathema triggers, does it trigger immediately, or does the minion
suffering from its effect still have the possibility to use Taste of Vitae to
avoid being burned?

Situation:

Minion A has 1 blood and suffers from Anathema
Minion B strikes for 1
Minion A strikes for 1 too and wants to play Taste of Vitae to avoid being
burned.

(We threw a coin and decited that A. triggers immediately)

2. A. triggers if the victim is reduced to 0 blood due to damage of the
opposing minion. What happens here?

Minion A has 1 blood, a Zip Gun and suffers from Anathema
Minion B strikes for 1
Minion A strikes with Zip Gun for 1, thus claiming to reduce his blood to zero
by his own damage "before" the other damage.

AFAIK regular damage is dealt simultanously in the resolution phase, so it
would require a mood (and in fact: it did. We ruled that Anathema triggered,
but with a bad feeling). We don't want a mood, we want a ruling.

Thanx

Michael Beer

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
MikeM...@my-dejanews.com wrote:
> And another two questions round the use of Anathema.
>
> 1. If Anathema triggers, does it trigger immediately, or does the minion
> suffering from its effect still have the possibility to use Taste of Vitae to
> avoid being burned?

It happens immediately, as indicated on card text. There are no set
'check for death phases', so the check is continuous.

> Situation:
> Minion A has 1 blood and suffers from Anathema
> Minion B strikes for 1
> Minion A strikes for 1 too and wants to play Taste of Vitae to avoid being
> burned.
>
> (We threw a coin and decited that A. triggers immediately)

Good coin.

> 2. A. triggers if the victim is reduced to 0 blood due to damage of the
> opposing minion. What happens here?
>
> Minion A has 1 blood, a Zip Gun and suffers from Anathema
> Minion B strikes for 1
> Minion A strikes with Zip Gun for 1, thus claiming to reduce his blood to zero
> by his own damage "before" the other damage.

1: The damage from the Zip Gun occurs during strike resolution, so
is sumultaneous with the opposing strike's damage.
2: Any source of damage, self-inflicted or no, is applicable.

> AFAIK regular damage is dealt simultanously in the resolution phase, so it
> would require a mood (and in fact: it did. We ruled that Anathema triggered,
> but with a bad feeling). We don't want a mood, we want a ruling.

Again, you have ruled well.
